summary.text: Ancient Tree Prison Cage is Chen Yi's immortal killer move. Intertwined trees form a cage that feeds on immortal killer moves and is hard to break.

claims.text: In Lang Ya blessed land, after the distinct immortal binding vine binds the silver giant of ancient battle formation Heavenly Giant Solor, cut vines become huge trees that circle it. Roots under the cloud soil gather into a ball, and the trunks stand as pillars. The silver giant breaks free of the vines and is immediately trapped. Hairy man Gu Immortals unleash offensive killer moves. Lang Ya land spirit finds that the most effective way to destroy it is the giant’s bare hands, so Heavenly Giant Solor slams punches and kicks at it.

Chen Yi uses it again on the immemorial rock dragon after immortal binding vine restricts it, trapping the dragon when it hits the ground. Without external help the dragon cannot break out of the vines, and definitely not this cage outside them, as the restriction grows thicker and tighter despite intense struggle. The silver giant later finds an opening and destroys it. Chen Yi asks whether they think it is so easy to break out of; a wooden hand then grabs the giant’s leg, and a wooden giant rises. That follow-up is the distinct killer move Giant Tree Divine Statue.

Fang Yuan tries to free the trapped immemorial rock dragon and cannot. The outer layer is too thick, so it is a pain to get through. He judges that the move is not immune to all immortal killer moves, and that they lack the necessary method; given time, his wisdom path methods could deduce and unravel it. He treats this as the essence of Genesis Lotus true inheritance killer moves, like reverse flow protection seal, and has the same feelings against the cage that Fairy Zi Wei had against that seal.

After Fang Yuan traps Feng Jiu Ge in yama battlefield, the super immortal formation is safe. If they can destroy the cage, the immemorial rock dragon would also be free, and Chen Yi would have to face the silver giant, the rock dragon, and the formation together.
Lang Ya land spirit moves the silver giant, resists an attack of giant tree divine statue, and crashes into the cage trapping the rock dragon.
Fang Yuan is without options against Chen Yi’s cage. He can only join the super immortal formation and Heavenly Giant Solor to deal with Chen Yi and Fairy Zi Wei of Heavenly Court.
Chen Yi’s battle style is not specialized in offense but in sustainability. Ancient tree prison cage and karma divine tree share that style.

Trapped in Fang Yuan’s super formation, Chen Yi still has great battle strength from immortal killer moves like ancient tree prison cage, giant tree divine statue, karma divine tree, and others, making those superb killer moves very difficult for Fang Yuan to handle.
